name: Visionary3D Studio Agentic Workflow
description: Langflow orchestration flow for parsing natural language prompts and triggering Blender 3D generation.

nodes.description: Accepts natural language 3D generation prompts from the user.
Breaks down prompts into geometry, material, and animation tasks using LLM reasoning.
Sends verified bpy execution scripts to the Visionary3D MCP server.
